name: openrouter-dictation
description: Dictate into the prompt box: records your microphone and transcribes it with your own OpenRouter key and the speech-to-text model you pick (ElevenLabs Scribe v2 by default).

apiKey.title: OpenRouter API key
apiKey.description: Your OpenRouter key (sk-or-...). You can also paste it into the dictation bar, or set the OPENROUTER_API_KEY environment variable.

model.title: Default transcription model
model.description: OpenRouter model id used until you pick another in the dictation bar.

speakers.title: Label speakers
speakers.description: Start with speaker recognition on: the transcript is split into Speaker 1, Speaker 2, ... on models that support it.

language.title: Default language
language.description: ISO-639-1 code such as en or nl; leave empty to auto-detect.
